stem: A cultivar has strong yield but repeatedly requires more canopy labor and a longer flower window than planned. How should it be evaluated operationally?
choices: Compare yield benefit against time, labor, space occupancy, quality, and scheduling effects before expanding its production share
Remove all lower-yield cultivars regardless of cycle time
Ignore labor because genetics are fixed
rationale: Genetic performance should be evaluated as a production system outcome, not a single output metric.
